when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the disease, condition, or finding is likely to interfere with study procedures.

name: patient_has_finding_of_disease_condition_finding_now@@likely_to_confound_evaluation_of_study_endpoints
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's disease, condition, or finding is likely to confound evaluation of study endpoints.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a disease, condition, or finding and it is likely to confound evaluation of study endpoints.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has a disease, condition, or finding and it is not likely to confound evaluation of study endpoints.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the disease, condition, or finding is likely to confound evaluation of study endpoints.

name: patient_survival_time_estimate_now_in_months
meaning: Numeric value representing the estimated survival time of the patient at the current time, in months.
when_unknown: Set to null if the estimated survival time in months is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the estimated number of months the patient is expected to survive as of now.
